name: code-fix
description: Same as v1 with one candidate per round: cascade instead of parallel. Adopted only if the A/B shows the second candidate is not buying a graded endpoint.

nodes.prompt: Inspect the repository and the task. Produce: (1) the exact failure or gap, (2) the files likely involved, (3) the verification command that proves success, (4) one alternative approach. Be terse; the next agent only needs the plan.

of.prompt: Implement the change in your own worktree. Run the project tests yourself. Report: what you changed, the commands you ran, and the final test output. Do not claim success without a green run.

nodes.description: Mechanical gate: exit code 0 required; extra metrics parsed from stdout when configured.
